text:
danielle: FYI customer escalated — sudden p95/p99 spike on rw-v2-13b in hosted. They say tail latencies jumped after last maintenance window. Shared sample payloads and traces, asking for quick mitigation.

maya: thanks — can you paste the exact numbers they gave?

danielle: customer report pasted: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms (was ~260), p99 ~920ms (was ~480). Errors are rare, mostly timeouts on long-context requests (>4k tokens). Happened after deploy ~3h ago. They included a cURL repro and a trace id: trace/ff12aa33.

liam: interesting — we rolled a compiler flag flip 3h ago (commit d4c8f2) that enabled SDPA-based kernel path for attention by default and enabled new fused kernel heuristics. Could be related.

sana: I already started sampling tails on prod pool rwpool-eu-1. Heatmap shows more variance for sequence lengths > 2048 and batch size 1. CPU host metrics look fine, GPU util steady. KV-cache growth looks normal.

jack: can we toggle the SDPA path for that pool as a quick experiment? Is there a feature flag we can flip?

liam: yes — we added env var RW_USE_SDPA=1/0 and RW_KERNEL_SELECTION=auto|sdpa_legacy|flashatn. For hosted rollout we defaulted to auto which prefers SDPA for attn size > 64.

maya: action plan: 1) repro locally, 2) toggle SDPA off for the affected pool, 3) if that helps, either pin kernel selection to sdpa_legacy or roll back the compile change.

danielle: customer wants a workaround ASAP (they're on Dedicated but using hosted endpoints). Requested ETA ~2hr.

liam: i'll try toggling RW_USE_SDPA=0 on a canary subset of rwpool-eu-1. Will monitor p95/p99.

deploy-bot: deploy started: toggle RW_USE_SDPA=0 -> rwpool-eu-1-canary (3 hosts). triggered by liam.

maya: while that's running, i'll try to reproduce locally with their payload. danielle — can you drop their cURL here?

danielle: pasted cURL: ```curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-v2-13b","input":"<long conversation>...","max_tokens":1024}'``` They said set temperature 0.2 and stream=false.

maya: repro script: ```python
import requests
h={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['RW_KEY'],'Content-Type':'application/json'}
body={'model':'rw-v2-13b','input':'<long>','max_tokens':1024,'temperature':0.2}
r=requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',json=body,headers=h,timeout=30)
print(r.elapsed.total_seconds()*1000)
``` Running locally I get p95 ~380ms baseline (different machine) but on a GPU cluster image with the new kernels I can reproduce p95 ~430ms for same payload.

liam: can you capture inference logs with kernel selection debug? Set RW_KERNEL_LOG=1 and capture the selected kernel per request.

maya: logs show: 70% of long-ctx requests chose kernel sdpa_fused_v2, 30% chose flash_attn_fallback. The sdpa_fused_v2 traces show attention kernel stall spikes where a single kernel invocation sometimes takes up to 600ms on long sequences.

sana: that aligns with perf counters I saw: when sdpa_fused_v2 runs we observe elevated L2 miss ratio and an occasional memory-copy stall on SMs 2/3. FlashAttention path has steady but slightly higher median, lower tail.

jack: is this input-shape dependent? customer said >4k tokens. sdpa heuristics probably mis-predicts for large kv sizes.

liam: the compile change enabled some new vectorization and a tiled-copy for SDPA which is faster on most shapes but regresses on >4k because of memory fragmentation + page alignment issues on certain GPUs. There's an opt-size threshold we mis-set.

maya: immediate mitigation if toggle helps: pin kernel selection to flash_attn for older >3k contexts. We can set RW_KERNEL_SELECTION=flash_attn for the pool. That's lower risk than full rollback.

deploy-bot: canary toggle completed. RW_USE_SDPA=0 applied to rwpool-eu-1-canary (3 hosts).

liam: monitoring dashboards... pulling p95/p99 for canary vs baseline.

sana: preliminary: canary p95 dropped from 420ms -> 260ms within two windows. p99 dropped from 920ms -> 480ms. Baseline hosts still high. So toggling off SDPA looks to help.

danielle: relaying to customer now: asked them to retry, told them we have a canary rollback in progress and we're observing improvements.

maya: good. Next steps: 1) expand toggle to full pool, 2) prepare a patch to fix heuristics (tune threshold for sdpa for >3k), 3) add extra monitoring to detect kernel stall spikes and auto-fallback.

liam: on heuristics — the commit added a static threshold TH_SDPA_MAX_KV=4096. We should bump to 6144 and add runtime probing: if avg kernel time > 2x baseline for 5 consecutive requests, mark host to prefer flash_attn for that model/shape. I'll open a PR.

jack: expand toggle to full pool in 15 mins if no regressions. Also we'll add a temporary kernel selector env: RW_KERNEL_SELECTION=flash_attn for rwpool-eu-1 until PR ships.

deploy-bot: rollout started: RW_KERNEL_SELECTION=flash_attn -> rwpool-eu-1 (15 hosts), triggered by jack.

sana: dashboards: global p95 for rw-v2-13b in eu region normalizing; tail spikes almost gone. Keep an eye on throughput (batching sometimes drops if heuristics change).

maya: one more thing — need a reproducible perf capture for the kernel team: dump cudaProfiler output and the kernel args for a worst-case request. I collected one and uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/kernel-dumps/1999999999/trace_ff12aa33.tar.gz

liam: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4312 — changes: bump TH_SDPA_MAX_KV, add runtime fallback when kernel tail exceeds threshold, and add debug counters exported to Prometheus (kernel_selected, kernel_latency_ms).

danielle: customer confirmed improvement after ~20 minutes of the full pool toggle and asked for postmortem + preventive actions.

maya: postmortem notes to include: root cause = mis-tuned SDPA fused kernel heuristics + new tiled-copy optimization regressed on certain >4k shapes on some GPU SKUs; mitigation = emergency toggle to flash_attn, then heuristics patch, added runtime fallback and metrics; follow-ups = more canary coverage for kernel changes, add automated tail-detection circuit breaker, test matrix across GPU SKUs for large KV sizes.

liam: also adding unit test that runs attention microbenchmark for sequences [512,1024,2048,3072,4096,6144] on CI images to catch regression.

jack: ops action: create a dashboard alarm on kernel_latency_percentile{kernel=\"sdpa_fused_v2\"} p99 > 2s for 5m -> page eng-runtime oncall.

sana: note for release: don't enable SDPA fused by default until we ship the patched heuristics and have the new metrics.

maya: thanks team. I'll draft the customer-facing summary and postmortem. danielle — can you coordinate the customer comms and let me know if they want a deeper tech writeup?

danielle: will do. they asked for a short explanation and the rollback steps we took, then we'll offer the deeper writeup. :thumbsup:

liam: PR merged to hotfix branch, will schedule a proper rollout after tests.

deploy-bot: rollback complete: RW_KERNEL_SELECTION set back to auto once patched heuristics are staged (monitoring alert set).

maya: closing loop here. If anyone sees residual tail, ping in this thread and we'll re-open.

jack: adding incident runbook note: Kernel-selection regressions -> toggle RW_KERNEL_SELECTION / RW_USE_SDPA, check kernel_latency_{p95,p99}, upload CUDA profilers, and escalate to eng-ml if pattern persists.

sana: saved flamegraphs and perf counters in the incident folder s3://redwood-incidents/1999999999/

maya: end of thread.
